comparator.name: Bachelor Automotive Technology
comparator.sourceNotes: TU/e's current official programme and study-guide pages, checked 2026-10-03, describe a three-year, 180-EC bachelor organised around the automotive major, an elective part and a Bachelor Final Project. The curriculum page for students starting in 2023-2024 and later identifies the complete 2025-2026 curriculum. The official elective page assigns 15 EC to the USE/ITEC learning line and 45 EC to elective study; the remaining 120 EC is the major and core programme, including its final project. That complete 120/15/45 allocation is retained below rather than inventing individual credits where the live course-list page does not publish them.
components: Automotive major and core programme, including Bachelor Final Project

Compulsory automotive and Bachelor College formation. The official major-course pages cover mathematics and computation, signals and systems, dynamics, electromagnetics, electronics, electromechanics, power electronics, sensing and actuation, electric and hybrid powertrains, road-vehicle dynamics, vehicle networking, control systems, automotive software engineering, autonomous driving and the Bachelor Final Project.

exception.reason: Automotive Technology is an integrated electrical, mechanical, computational and control-engineering degree. Its compulsory formation moves from mathematics, computation, signals, systems, dynamics, electromagnetics, electronics and electromechanics into power electronics, sensing and actuation, electric and hybrid powertrain design, road-vehicle dynamics, vehicle networking, control systems, automotive software engineering, autonomous driving, automotive projects and a Bachelor Final Project. UCR offers useful mathematics, programming, data science, image processing, AI, robotics, linear systems, consumer-product design and sustainable-energy courses. It does not provide the required physics and electrical-engineering progression, vehicle mechanics and dynamics, electric-powertrain engineering, embedded and real-time automotive systems, vehicle communications, engineering laboratories, staged automotive design projects or an equivalent automotive capstone. A UCR pathway could address intelligent mobility, vehicle data and sustainable transport as an interdisciplinary theme, but it would not be a defensible Automotive Technology comparator.
exception.curriculumContext: The official current curriculum structure accounts for the full 180 EC: 120 EC of automotive major and Bachelor College core formation, including the Bachelor Final Project, plus a 60-EC elective part consisting of a 15-EC USE/ITEC learning line and 45 EC of electives. The major-course pages identify a deliberately integrated engineering spine: computation and mathematics; signals, systems and dynamics; electromagnetics, electronics, electromechanics and power electronics; sensing and actuation; electric and hybrid powertrain design; road-vehicle dynamics; vehicle networking; control systems; automotive software engineering; autonomous driving; projects; and the final project. The live programme page characterises the vehicle as a controlled high-tech system combining mechanics, electronics, sensors and informatics rather than as a general transport or sustainability subject.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 current enriched UCR workbook rows, including descriptions, outline-derived profiles, disciplines, topics, methods, prerequisites and planned Fall 2026 cohort terms. DISGATE102 Mathematical Methods, DISMATH211 Linear Algebra, DISMATH213 Computational & Numerical Methods, DISMATH214 Advanced Calculus, DISMATH312 Linear Systems and DISMATH314 Probability & Statistics provide relevant quantitative foundations. DISGATE101 Introduction to Programming, DISCOMP213 Software Development, DISDATA111 Introduction to Data Science, DISDATA211 Machine Learning, DISDATA212 Image Processing & Computer Vision, DISDATA311 Neural Networks & Deep Learning and DISDATA312 Robotics support computation, perception, planning and general control-related work. BENENTR111 Consumer Product Design adds team-based product development, while ENSGATE101 Sustainability Essentials I, ENSSUST112 Life Cycle Analysis & Circular Economy, ENSSUST211 Energy & Sustainability and ENSSUST311 Renewable System Design support environmental and energy perspectives. The workbook nevertheless contains no mechanics or vehicle-dynamics sequence, electromagnetics, circuit and electronics sequence, electromechanical energy conversion, power electronics, electric or hybrid powertrain design, automotive sensing-and-actuation laboratory, embedded systems, real-time automotive software, in-vehicle networking, automotive safety and reliability engineering, vehicle-systems integration project, or automotive Bachelor Final Project. DISMATH312 studies linear systems from an engineering perspective but cannot replace the target's staged control, electronics and vehicle laboratories. DISDATA212 and DISDATA312 cover general computer vision and robotics rather than automotive perception hardware, vehicle networking and validated autonomous-driving systems. The available UCR courses therefore support an interdisciplinary intelligent-mobility theme while leaving the target programme's defining physical-engineering, embedded-systems, laboratory and capstone formation unmatched.
